metadata.description: Automate a small file-processing workflow with validation, dry-run behavior and reliable totals.

project.name: Expense summary CSV
project.brief: Complete summarize(rows) in starter/summarize.py for the supplied expense CSV. Sum integer cents by category, including negative refunds. Reject duplicate IDs and non-integer amounts. Default invocation previews JSON; --output writes a NEW file only. Preserve input bytes.

sources.name: brief.md
sources.content: Complete summarize(rows) in starter/summarize.py for the supplied expense CSV. Sum integer cents by category, including negative refunds. Reject duplicate IDs and non-integer amounts. Default invocation previews JSON; --output writes a NEW file only. Preserve input bytes.

sources.name: acceptance.md
sources.content:
- Office total is 4200 cents; Travel total is 6500 cents for expenses.csv.
- Empty input produces an empty summary. Negative refunds reduce totals.
- Duplicate IDs, missing category/ID and invalid integer amounts raise a clear error.
- JSON category order is deterministic; no output path means stdout only.
- Existing output files are never overwritten; input files remain unchanged.

requirements: Cohandry 0.1.13 or later and your own supported model connection.
Python 3.10+ and an approved execution host; no packages, bank access or external services.
Use only the fictional fixture CSVs until you have reviewed the behavior.
